documents.prompt: Two pricing plans are modeled by the two lines in the workspace. Use the GRAPH to estimate the break-even point to about the nearest tenth; classify the system and enter the intersection coordinates.

context.scenario: Two pricing plans with different starting fees and rates

solutionReview.headline: A graphical solution is the coordinate where both real-world models have the same output.
reasoning: The two lines intersect at approximately $({{xstar}},{{ystar}})$.
Because the task is graphical estimation, a coordinate read to about the nearest tenth is appropriate; substituting into both models can verify the estimate.

attemptFeedback: Read both coordinates from the crossing point, not from where either line crosses an axis.
supportHints: Trace both lines to their intersection, then project to the x- and y-axes.
